column2: Phew... maybe I'll push a little longer...
While wandering idly through the school building,<LF>I found a girl giving it her all on the grounds alone――Meru.
Solo practice? You're really working hard, Meru.
I can't afford to hold everyone back,<LF>so I make sure never to skip physical training either.
Your physical ability was already high to begin with,<LF>and I don't think you'd ever hold anyone back...
Even so, when I think I might be able to help someone,<LF>I don't want to cut corners.
I see. But if you keep repeating the same routine,<LF>won't you get bored?
How about trying some different training too?
I see... that does sound good!<LF>What kind of training do you think would be good?
Since I'm here anyway, how about training that you can't do<LF>without a machine? I'll help you out.
Like shoulder presses or lying leg curls,<LF>those become possible with two people.
B-But that means... we'd be pressed right up against each other, right!?
Ah, that's true... sorry, I hadn't thought that far.<LF>Let's not after a――
No, let's do it!!!!
Huh, ah... sure?
That one, it's the "strike while the iron is hot" thing! Let's train a lot!
And so, with Meru suddenly far more motivated,<LF>I ended up keeping her company until dusk.
For example, how about picturing a one-on-one close-quarters<LF>fight with me focused on hand-to-hand combat?
Close-quarters combat with %usernameusernameuserna%-san... just the two of us!?
What was that, we should have used the same words,<LF>but it felt like she took it in a whole different sense... oh well.
(Just what kind of image training is she running...?<LF>As expected of Meru... such incredible focus...)
%usernameusernameuserna%-san...!<LF>Targeting a spot like that so relentlessly is...!
!? Just what am I doing inside her imagination!?
Ah...! What kind of image training was I running...!
No, seriously!? What kind of image training was it!?
Eh...!? %usernameusernameuserna%-san so persistently...<LF>I-I can't say any more than thiiiiis!!
Huh...
Her face bright red, Meru went running off...
ペアトレーニングなんてどう？
イメージトレーニングだ
